verses.mystical_translation: A life can stay fruitful by remaining rooted in praise rather than performance.
The poem enters through sabbath song, praise, music, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.

safety_note: Flourishing imagery is wisdom poetry, not a promise that righteous people will always be healthy, wealthy, or physically vigorous.
